description: This file is a Java test class 'AbstractInitSalesManagerCore' used for initializing data (languages, countries, zones, currencies) in the SalesManager Core system during testing. It contains setup methods, test methods, and cleanup routines to prepare the test environment.

classes.name: AbstractInitSalesManagerCore
classes.description: Java test class for initializing sales manager core data such as languages, countries, zones, and currencies during testing.

methods.name: clean
methods.description: Prepares the environment by cleaning existing data and verifying database is empty.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Main test method to initialize languages, countries, and zones.

methods.name: initZones
methods.description: Initializes zone data based on loadZoneConfigurations.

methods.name: initCountries
methods.description: Creates country entries based on locale data.

methods.name: initLanguages
methods.description: Creates language entries based on predefined codes.

methods.name: initCurrencies
methods.description: Creates currency entries, currently commented out in main init.

methods.name: cleanAll
methods.description: Deletes all existing currencies, countries, languages, and zones from the database.

methods.name: checkEmptyDatabase
methods.description: Asserts that no entities remain in the database after cleanup.

methods.name: listEntities
methods.description: Generic method to list all entities of a given class.

methods.name: getEntityManager
methods.description: Retrieves the EntityManager instance from EntityManagerUtils.
